title: Implement the scaffold command
description: Add cli/lib/scaffold.js and dispatch `appbuilder scaffold <slug> [--force]` from the router (replacing the placeholder). Gate on compilePlan, require build_type present with an available template, copy templates/<build_type>/files/ into build/<slug>/ with {{variable}} substitution, assert required_files were produced, write+validate build/<slug>/scaffold-report.json. Scope the test runner to tests/ so generated stubs are not discovered. Refuse to overwrite build/<slug>/ unless --force. Test-first.
acceptance_criteria: appbuilder scaffold <slug> renders templates/cli into build/<slug>/ with {{slug}}/{{summary}} substituted, and writes a valid scaffold-report.json.
scaffold gates on compile and fails clearly when build_type is missing or has no template; refuses an existing build/<slug>/ without --force and overwrites with it.
scripts.test is scoped to tests/ so generated build/<slug>/test stubs are not run; full suite passes and doctor is green.
